OnPlay.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7), CONFIRMED against current source 2026-08-04 -- and simplified further since. JackOfAllTrades.cs:31-33 names `Rng.CombatCardGeneration`. The card no longer branches on `crng.is_parity` at all (colorless_skills.py:448-451): it passes `ctx.combat.combat_rng.card_gen` straight into `random_pool_cards`, and `CombatRng.card_gen` (combat_rng.py:50) resolves to the correct stream in BOTH modes -- `CombatRng.legacy(self._rng)` (combat_rng.py:38-39) maps every accessor including `card_gen` back onto the one shared `random.Random`, so legacy/RL runs are byte-for-byte unchanged, while `CombatRng.parity(rng_set)` (combat_rng.py:41-46) maps it onto `GameRandomAdapter(rng_set.combat_card_generation)` for string-seeded runs. This is a strictly simpler and equally-correct shape than the old is_parity-branching pattern `card/infernal_blade` still carries. The Colorless pool and the self-exclusion (colorless_skills.py:446,450) remain faithful and untouched. Pinned by test/test_card_residue_gaps.py (file still present, verified by glob).
